correctness.rationale: The cyclic boundary model is taken from arXiv:math/0610829. The Wang sequence over \(\mathbf F_2\) gives \(H_{d-1}\cong\mathbf F_2\) for the sphere bundle. A nonzero \(d-1\)-cycle needs at least \(d+1\) support vertices; at equality it is a simplex boundary. The cyclic-gap argument classifies every missing \(d\)-simplex as one of the \(2d+3\) consecutive interior \(d\)-faces. Exact mod-two boundary computations for \(3\le d\le7\) independently reproduce the classification and nontriviality. Risk: finite replay is only corroborative; the infinite proof carries the universal quantifier.

value.rationale: The invariant is naturally forced by the unique mod-two fiber class in a canonical vertex-minimal family. The theorem is uniform for every \(d\ge3\), gives the sharp support value and classifies every minimizer, and links the cyclic handle construction to a reusable local-to-global homology property. It is not an arbitrary parameter slice or a one-off computation. Limitation: no larger-support spectrum is claimed.
